setting: 夜の帰り道、久しぶりに元カノへ電話する
lyrics:
All my friends are drunk again
And I'm stumblin' back to bed all by myself
Don't need nobody else
All my friends are drunk again
And I'm stumblin' back to bed all by myself
Don't need nobody else

[Verse 1]
Smell like smoke, nuit de l'homme
It's been a while since we last spoke
So tell me, how's it go?
Still love blues, nothin' new
Careless love, I've had a few
How 'bout you?

[Chorus]
All my friends are drunk again
And I'm stumblin' back to bed all by myself
Don't need nobody else
All my friends are drunk again
And I'm stumblin' back to bed all by myself
Don't need nobody else

[Verse 2]
I never have thought
When you're gone
I'd find it hard to carry on
And it's probably 'cause
I fell in love way back then
And I think about us when
I think about us when

[Chorus]
All my friends are drunk again
And I'm stumblin' back to bed all by myself
I got nobody else
All my friends are drunk again
And I'm stumblin' back to bed all by myself
I got, I got nobody else

[Outro]
Ooh-ooh, ooh-ooh, ooh-ooh, no-no
Ooh, ooh, ooh-ooh, ooh

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Hey, Mia, it's been a while since we last spoke.
sentences.displayHtml: Hey, Mia, it's been a while since we last spoke.

conversation.japanese: ねえ、ミア。久しぶりだね。今、話しても大丈夫？

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: I'm still awake, but you sound tired.
sentences.displayHtml: I'm still awake, but you sound tired.

sentences.text: Are you on your way home?
sentences.displayHtml: Are you on your way home?

conversation.japanese: 私はまだ起きてるけど、あなたは疲れてるみたいだね。帰るところ？

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I thought moving on would be easier, but it's been hard to carry on.
sentences.displayHtml: I thought moving on would be easier, but it's been hard to carry on.

conversation.japanese: うん。もっと簡単に前に進めると思ってたけど、なかなかつらくて。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: But we don't have to figure out everything about us tonight.
sentences.displayHtml: But we don't have to figure out everything about us tonight.

conversation.japanese: わかるよ。でも、今夜、私たちのことを全部決めなくていい。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I think I just wanted to hear your voice.
sentences.displayHtml: I think I just wanted to hear your voice.

conversation.japanese: そうだね。ただ君の声が聞きたかったんだと思う。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: Then stay on the phone until you get home.
sentences.displayHtml: Then stay on the phone until you get home.

conversation.japanese: じゃあ、家に着くまで電話してよう。普通に話せばいいよ。

lyricConnections.lyricExpression: It's been a while since we last spoke
lyricConnections.conversationExpression: It's been a while since we last spoke
lyricConnections.explanationJa: It's been a while since ... は、最後に何かをしてから時間がたったことを表す。
carry on は、つらい状況でも生活や行動を続けること。
